description: A round town enclosed by a tall wooden palisade of upright stakes, seen from above at a slant, sitting on a grassy shore. Inside the wall is a pale grey yard with a few small red-roofed houses and dark doorways; a gate breaks the front of the wall. Green and grey-speckled grass and bushes surround it, fading to teal at the bottom. Behind the town the sea stretches dark blue to a thin strip of bright cyan sky, and a small sailing ship with a single white sail floats on the water at the top center. The colors are greens, blues and warm reds; the mood is calm and far-off. Frame 1: the sea and ship rest in one position. Frame 2: the water shimmers and the ship rocks gently. Both frames are held for the same short time, so the loop reads as a gentle ripple of waves and a softly bobbing ship.
title: Walled town by the sea
